title: RayViT: Ray-Conditioned Visual Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Imitation Learning
summary: Visual imitation learning enables robots to acquire visuomotor skills directly from images, yet RGB observations lack explicit geometric cues, making learned policies brittle to camera perturbations. To address this, we propose \textbf{Ray-conditioned Vision Transformer Encoder (RayViT)}, a lightweight architecture that injects camera geometry into pretrained ViT backbones. RayViT represents camera geometry as a Plücker ray map, patchifies it into ray features, and uses gated cross-attention to produce a ray-conditioned class token. These ray features are added as dense positional embeddings, while the ray class token replaces the original ViT class token to provide a geometry-aware summary representation. We combine this approach with an auxiliary cosine similarity loss to consistently improve the performance and robustness for geometry-aware tokens. Experiments on sim- and real-robot tasks demonstrate that RayViT improves robustness by approximately 13 percentage points under camera perturbations in multi-task RoboCasa benchmark and by 1.78 average completed stages in real-world multi-task success rate compared to baselines.
summary_zh: 视觉模仿学习使机器人能够直接从图像中获取视觉运动技能，然而RGB观测缺乏显式几何线索，导致所学策略对相机扰动较为脆弱。为解决这一问题，我们提出**射线条件视觉变换器编码器（RayViT）**，这是一种轻量级架构，可将相机几何信息注入预训练的ViT骨干网络。RayViT将相机几何表示为Plücker射线图，将其分块化为射线特征，并通过门控交叉注意力生成射线条件类别令牌。这些射线特征作为密集位置嵌入被添加，而射线类别令牌则替代原始ViT类别令牌，以提供几何感知的总结性表示。我们将该方法与辅助余弦相似性损失相结合，持续提升几何感知令牌的性能与鲁棒性。在仿真与真实机器人任务上的实验表明，与基线方法相比，RayViT在多任务RoboCasa基准测试的相机扰动下将鲁棒性提升了约13个百分点，并在真实世界多任务成功率中平均多完成1.78个阶段。
tldr: RayViT injects camera geometry into a pretrained ViT backbone via Plücker ray features and gated cross-attention, significantly improving the robustness of visual imitation learning policies under camera perturbations.
tldr_zh: RayViT 通过将普吕克射线特征和门控交叉注意力注入预训练 ViT 骨干网络，显著提升了视觉模仿学习策略在摄像机扰动下的鲁棒性。

title: WCM: A World Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models has shown strong promise for robotic manipulation. Among RL methods, critic-based approaches rely on a value estimator that predominantly operates on single-frame observations or single-frame VLM backbone latents, which is a fundamental mismatch with the partially observable nature of robot control. A naive approach to incorporate observation history into the critic incurs exponential complexity with high-dimensional visual space, and still fails because pure scalar-return regression provides insufficient supervision for learning cross-temporal dynamics. We identify the root cause as a state approximation problem: without an explicit world modeling objective, the critic's representation cannot capture the temporal structure needed for accurate value estimation. To address this, we propose the World Critic Model (WCM), built on a lightweight LeJEPA architecture; WCM jointly predicts future latent state and estimates values, such that the critic's representation is explicitly trained to capture temporal dynamics rather than merely regress scalar returns. WCM integrates seamlessly into both on-policy and off-policy training pipelines and is compatible with state-of-the-art VLA backbones including Pi0, Pi0.5, and OpenVLA-OFT. Extensive experiments on 149 tasks across four benchmarks demonstrate that WCM consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, with particularly strong generalization gains. We further validate WCM on seven real-world manipulation tasks using OpenVLA-OFT and Pi0.5 with off-policy RL, confirming stable deployment across diverse settings.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的后训练已展现出在机器人操作中的强大潜力。在各类RL方法中，基于评论家的方法依赖于一个主要基于单帧观测或单帧VLM骨干网络潜在表示的价值估计器，这与机器人控制的部分可观测特性存在根本性不匹配。一种将观测历史纳入评论家的朴素方法会因高维视觉空间而导致指数级复杂度，并且由于纯标量回报回归无法为学习跨时间动态提供充分监督，该方法依然会失效。我们将根本原因归结为状态近似问题：缺乏显式的世界建模目标，导致评论家的表征无法捕捉精确价值估计所需的时间结构。为解决该问题，我们提出世界评论家模型（WCM），该模型基于轻量级LeJEPA架构构建；WCM联合预测未来潜在状态并估计价值，从而使评论家的表征被显式训练以捕捉时间动态，而不仅仅是回归标量回报。WCM可无缝集成到同策略与异策略训练流程中，并与包括Pi0、Pi0.5及OpenVLA-OFT在内的最先进VLA骨干网络兼容。在四个基准测试平台的149项任务上的大量实验表明，WCM在分布内和分布外场景中均持续达到最先进性能，尤其展现出强大的泛化增益。我们进一步通过异策略RL，使用OpenVLA-OFT和Pi0.5在七项真实世界操作任务上验证了WCM，确认其在多样化场景下的稳定部署能力。
tldr: Proposes a World Critic Model (WCM) that integrates a lightweight latent world model into VLA reinforcement learning to improve temporal representation and value estimation, achieving SOTA on 149 robotic manipulation tasks and real-world validation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种世界评论模型，将轻量级潜在世界模型融入视觉-语言-动作强化学习中，以改进时间表征和值估计，在149个机器人操作任务和真实世界验证中达到SOTA。

title: BWM: A Low-Cost High-Fidelity World Simulator for Robot Learning
summary: Reliable robot learning requires a world simulator that can predict action consequences before execution on physical hardware, including risky and failure-prone outcomes. Existing physics simulators require substantial asset construction and calibration and still face a sim-to-real gap, while video generators often lack precise control over their responses to fine-grained robot actions. In this paper, we present the Boundless World Model (BWM), an open-source, low-cost, high-fidelity world simulator for robot manipulation. BWM is an action-conditioned world model that combines initial-environment guidance, dynamic visual history, and temporally aligned robot-action conditioning for stateful autoregressive prediction of future observations. We construct action-aligned training clips through trajectory replay, overlapping clip sampling, and initial-observation enhancement. BWM serves as a data engine that augments imitation-learning data with action-aligned rollouts, and as a policy evaluator for closed-loop assessment, risk anticipation, and policy ranking. Experiments on the WorldArena benchmark and physical robots demonstrate improved simulator fidelity and functional utility across the data-engine and policy-evaluator settings. BWM ranks first overall in the WorldArena Challenge across Track 1 and its two Track 2 applications. We release the BWM open-source ecosystem, including model checkpoints, training and inference code, and interfaces for data generation and policy evaluation.
summary_zh: 可靠的机器人学习需要一个能够在物理硬件实际执行之前预测动作后果的世界模拟器，包括高风险和易失败的结果。现有的物理模拟器需要大量资产构建与校准，仍面临模拟到现实的差异问题，而视频生成器往往缺乏对精细粒度机器人动作响应的精确控制。本文提出无限世界模型——一个开源、低成本、高保真的机器人操作世界模拟器。作为动作条件世界模型，BWM融合初始环境引导、动态视觉历史与时间对齐的机器人动作条件，实现对未来观测的有状态自回归预测。我们通过轨迹回放、重叠片段采样与初始观测增强构建动作对齐的训练片段。BWM既可作为数据引擎，通过动作对齐的展开轨迹增强模仿学习数据；也可作为策略评估器，用于闭环评估、风险预判与策略排序。在WorldArena基准测试与实体机器人上的实验表明，该模型在数据引擎与策略评估两种场景中均提升了模拟器保真度与功能效用。BWM在WorldArena挑战赛赛道1及其两个赛道2应用中综合排名第一。我们发布了BWM开源生态系统，包含模型权重、训练与推理代码，以及数据生成与策略评估接口。
tldr: BWM is a low-cost, high-fidelity action-conditioned world model for robot manipulation that combines initial-environment guidance and dynamic visual history for autoregressive future prediction, serving as both a data engine for imitation learning and a closed-loop policy evaluator.
tldr_zh: BWM 是一种低成本、高保真的动作条件世界模型，用于机器人操作，结合初始环境引导和动态视觉历史进行自回归未来预测，既可作为模仿学习的数据引擎，也可作为闭环策略评估器。

title: FBFM: A Training-Free Asynchronous Feedback Mechanism for Flow-Matching in World-Action Models Execution
summary: Although world-action models (WAMs) enhance long-horizon robot control by predicting visual evolution before acting, long-horizon reliability demands repeated re-grounding in real observations--not recursive rollout. Existing WAMs address this by refreshing history or KV cache with ground-truth data between chunks. However, such chunk-wise feedback operates at a coarse temporal granularity and thus fails to correct prediction errors at the individual time-step level. To address this, we propose Feedback Flow Matching (FBFM), a training-free inference mechanism that pushes re-grounding inside the actively generated chunk. During flow matching, FBFM applies a masked pseudoinverse correction to the conditional velocity field: it leverages the preceding action chunk to guide generation of the next action chunk, and uses the image observed after executing that preceding chunk to guide the next frame prediction. This cross-chunk pairing--where feedback from one chunk arrives in time to shape the next--creates an asynchronous loop that corrects errors without waiting for chunk boundaries. Being training-free, the mechanism improves responsiveness to unexpected events and suppresses drift in long-horizon tasks. We evaluate FBFM on both a joint-generation WAM (DreamZero) and a stage-wise WAM (LingBot-VA). On selected LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0 tasks, it improves success rates by over 5% in favorable settings, and real-world robot observation-prediction diagnostics show notably better tracking. We argue that FBFM offers a new paradigm for fine-grained online correction, bridging open-loop flow generation with closed-loop real-world dynamics.
summary_zh: 尽管世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过在执行前预测视觉演化来增强长时域机器人控制，但长时域可靠性要求对真实观测进行反复重新接地——而非递归式展开。现有WAMs通过在分块间使用真实数据刷新历史记录或键值缓存来解决这一问题。然而，这种分块级反馈在粗糙的时间粒度下运作，因此无法在单个时间步层级纠正预测误差。为解决此问题，我们提出反馈流匹配（FBFM），一种无需训练的推理机制，将重新接地过程推入主动生成的分块内部。在流匹配过程中，FBFM对条件速度场施加掩码伪逆校正：它利用前一个动作分块引导下一个动作分块的生成，并利用执行前一动作分块后观测到的图像引导下一帧预测。这种跨分块配对——一个分块的反馈及时到达以塑造下一个分块——创建了一个异步循环，无需等待分块边界即可纠正误差。由于无需训练，该机制提高了对突发事件的响应能力，并抑制了长时域任务中的漂移。我们在联合生成型WAM（DreamZero）和分阶段型WAM（LingBot-VA）上评估了FBFM。在选定的LIBERO和RoboTwin2.0任务中，该方法在有利设置下将成功率提升了超过5%，且真实世界机器人观测预测诊断显示出显著更优的跟踪性能。我们认为FBFM为细粒度在线校正提供了新范式，弥合了开环流生成与闭环真实世界动力学之间的鸿沟。
tldr: This paper introduces FBFM, a training-free feedback mechanism that applies masked pseudoinverse correction to the conditional velocity field in flow matching for world-action models, improving error correction in long-horizon robot control by pushing re-grounding inside actively generated chunks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FBFM，一种无需训练的反馈机制，通过对流匹配中的条件速度场应用掩码伪逆校正，将重新接地推入主动生成的块内，从而改进世界动作模型在长时域机器人控制中的误差修正。

title: Diagnosing Compositional Generalization in Sequential Robot Tasks
summary: Sequential robot manipulation requires policies to execute novel combinations of familiar instruction components. However, collecting demonstrations for all possible instruction tuples is combinatorially expensive, while sparsely covered datasets often fail under out-of-distribution recombination. This paper studies compositional generalization through the lens of instruction-space coverage. We decompose the generalization gap into three sources: \textit{marginal instruction shift}, \textit{instruction-compositional shift}, and \textit{context--action shift}. This decomposition allows us to diagnose when sparse training coverage is sufficient, and what structure the training set must preserve for reliable action prediction. Our results show that exhaustive tuple enumeration is unnecessary: a structured subset, as small as one quarter of the full task space, can recover strong out-of-distribution performance when it covers action-relevant dependencies. We further find that sparse training often fails due to instruction steering rather than missing low-level skills; finetuning only one demonstration per task improves OOD success from \(0.4\%\) to \(54.7\%\). For semantically dependent tasks, effective coverage must capture relational structure rather than only factor diversity. These findings suggest that efficient robot data collection should prioritize dependency coverage in instruction space over exhaustive task expansion. More results are available in the supplementary material. Project website: https://yixiaowang7.github.io/Diagnosing_Compositional_Generalization_Robot_Page/.
summary_zh: 顺序机器人操控需要策略能够执行熟悉指令组件的全新组合。然而，为所有可能的指令元组采集演示数据在组合上成本高昂，而稀疏覆盖的数据集在遇到分布外组合时往往失效。本文从指令空间覆盖的视角研究组合泛化问题。我们将泛化差距分解为三个来源：\textit{边际指令偏移}、\textit{指令组合偏移}和\textit{上下文-动作偏移}。这一分解使我们能够判断稀疏训练覆盖在何时足够，以及训练集必须保留何种结构以实现可靠的动作预测。结果表明，穷举元组枚举并非必要：一个结构化子集——仅占完整任务空间四分之一大小——若覆盖了与动作相关的依赖关系，即可恢复出强大的分布外性能。我们进一步发现，稀疏训练失败常源于指令引导而非底层技能缺失；每个任务仅微调一个演示即可将分布外成功率从\(0.4\%\)提升至\(54.7\%\)。对于语义依赖任务，有效覆盖必须捕捉关系结构而不仅仅是因子多样性。这些发现表明，高效的机器人数据采集应优先关注指令空间中的依赖覆盖，而非穷举式任务扩展。更多结果详见补充材料。项目网站：https://yixiaowang7.github.io/Diagnosing_Compositional_Generalization_Robot_Page/。
tldr: This paper decomposes the compositional generalization gap in sequential robot tasks into three sources and shows that sparse instruction-space coverage can achieve strong out-of-distribution performance if it captures action-relevant dependencies.
tldr_zh: 本文将顺序机器人任务中的组合泛化差距分解为三个来源，并表明稀疏的指令空间覆盖只要捕获了与动作相关的依赖关系，就能实现强大的分布外性能。

title: FibVLA: An Efficient Temporal Vision-Language-Action Model with Fibonacci Sampling
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs), which leverage the cognition of multimodal information to infer physical-world actions, provide a generalized solution for embodied AI applications. Conventional VLAs usually concentrate on current digital cognition. While some efforts are made to enhance VLAs' reasoning capabilities by capturing temporal information, encoding the long-context history causes an efficiency-decreasing issue. To reconcile the conflict between capturing temporal information and maintaining inference efficiency in VLAs, this paper introduces FibVLA, an efficient framework featuring temporal perception of long-context history. Specifically, we leverage logarithmic hindsight sampling to both proprioceptive states and visual frames to capture long-term temporal dependencies with minimal redundancy. For the action expert, we introduce the flow matching to produce action distributions, and the Fibonacci recurrent inference strategy to generate long-range planning steps based on real-time closed-loop feedback. Experiments demonstrate that FibVLA significantly improves action smoothness and success rates without retraining large-scale visual encoders. Efficiency analysis demonstrates superior real-time responsiveness compared to video-based baselines in real-world evaluations.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）利用多模态信息认知来推断物理世界动作，为具身智能应用提供了通用化解决方案。传统VLAs通常聚焦于当前数字认知。尽管已有研究通过捕捉时序信息来增强VLAs的推理能力，但编码长程历史上下文会导致效率下降问题。为解决VLAs中捕捉时序信息与保持推理效率之间的矛盾，本文提出FibVLA——一个具备长程上下文时序感知能力的高效框架。具体而言，我们采用对数回溯采样技术处理本体感知状态与视觉帧，以最小冗余度捕捉长程时序依赖关系。针对动作专家模块，我们引入流匹配生成动作分布，并设计斐波那契递归推理策略，基于实时闭环反馈产生长程规划步骤。实验表明，FibVLA在无需重新训练大规模视觉编码器的情况下，显著提升了动作平滑度与成功率。效率分析证明，在实际场景评估中，该方法相比基于视频的基线方法具有更优越的实时响应能力。
tldr: FibVLA introduces Fibonacci sampling and flow matching to efficiently handle long-context temporal history in VLA models, improving action smoothness and success rates without retraining large visual encoders.
tldr_zh: FibVLA通过斐波那契采样和流匹配高效处理VLA模型中的长程时间历史，在不重新训练大型视觉编码器的情况下提升动作平滑度和成功率。

title: Safe Vision Language Action Models via Barrier Enhanced Flow Matching
summary: This article presents a modular inference framework that integrates Flow Matching generative models with formal Control Barrier Function (CBF) safety guarantees. Unlike existing methods that apply external safety filters to a model's final output, our approach modifies the Flow Matching denoising process within the model to inherently generate safe trajectories. By employing a smooth Log-Sum-Exponential aggregate barrier, we enforce safety over entire action chunks. This aggregate barrier ensures a minimal increase in computational overhead and does not alter the semantic intent of the model. We show that, within the proposed framework, the 2-Wasserstein distance between the generated distribution and the target distribution remains bounded. Our method eliminates the need for safety-specific datasets or costly model retraining, providing a versatile solution for safe inference. We validate the approach on two robotic manipulation platforms and a 2D navigation benchmark, verifying that our framework achieves reliable safety without degrading the success rate of the model.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种模块化推理框架，将流匹配生成模型与形式化的控制障碍函数（CBF）安全保证相结合。与现有方法在模型最终输出上应用外部安全滤波器不同，我们的方法在模型内部修改流匹配去噪过程，从而固有地生成安全轨迹。通过采用平滑的对数-和-指数聚合障碍函数，我们在整个动作片段上保障了安全性。这种聚合障碍函数仅带来极小的计算开销增加，且不会改变模型的语义意图。我们证明，在该框架下，生成分布与目标分布之间的2-瓦瑟斯坦距离保持有界。该方法无需专门的安全数据集或昂贵的模型重训练，为安全推理提供了一种通用解决方案。我们在两个机器人操作平台和一个二维导航基准任务上对该方法进行了验证，结果表明该框架在实现可靠安全性的同时，未降低模型的任务成功率。
tldr: This paper presents a modular inference framework that integrates Flow Matching generative models with Control Barrier Function (CBF) safety guarantees, modifying the denoising process to inherently generate safe trajectories while maintaining computational efficiency and semantic intent.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模块化推理框架，将流匹配生成模型与控制屏障函数（CBF）安全保证相结合，通过修改去噪过程内生生成安全轨迹，同时保持计算效率和语义意图。

title: Temporal Policy: History-Initialized Action Generation for Robotic Learning from Demonstration
summary: By relying on independent couplings from uninformative Gaussian priors, standard diffusion and flow matching models are forced to learn complex, high-cost vector fields to reach the physical action space. Generative models excel at capturing multimodal behaviors for robotic Learning from Demonstration (LfD), but often suffer from high inference cost. This paper introduces Temporal Policy, a generative framework based on stochastic interpolants that formulates action generation as a temporally coupled transport problem. By initializing the generative flow at the robot's recent history, we explicitly couple past states to future action sequences. This data-dependent coupling reduces transport cost and produces straight vector fields. We validate Temporal Policy across visuomotor simulation benchmarks and on a physical Barrett WAM 2x 7DoF teleoperation platform. Our approach reduces transport costs by nearly an order of magnitude compared to noise-initialized baselines, achieving a 19.1 ms inference latency on a single NVIDIA RTX 4080. Crucially, these geometric and computational efficiencies are achieved while matching the success rates of state-of-the-art baselines. This simplified transport geometry bypasses the computational bottleneck of independent Gaussian priors, helping enable high-frequency, closed-loop control. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/dmiller12/TemporalPolicy.
summary_zh: 依据非信息高斯先验的独立耦合，标准扩散模型与流匹配模型被迫学习复杂、高成本的向量场以到达物理动作空间。生成式模型擅长捕捉机器人示教学习中的多模态行为，但常受限于高推理成本。本文提出时序策略——一种基于随机插值器的生成框架，将动作生成表述为时间耦合的输运问题。通过将生成流初始化为机器人的近期历史，我们显式地将过去状态与未来动作序列耦合。这种数据依赖的耦合降低了输运成本，并生成笔直的向量场。我们在视觉运动模拟基准测试及物理Barrett WAM 2x 7自由度遥操作平台上验证了时序策略。与基于噪声初始化的基线方法相比，我们的方法将输运成本降低近一个数量级，在单块NVIDIA RTX 4080上实现19.1毫秒的推理延迟。关键在于，在匹配最先进基线方法成功率的同时，实现了这些几何与计算效率的提升。这种简化的输运几何结构绕过了独立高斯先验的计算瓶颈，有助于实现高频闭环控制。代码已开源，参见https://github.com/dmiller12/TemporalPolicy。
tldr: Temporal Policy introduces a generative framework based on stochastic interpolants that initializes action generation from the robot's recent history, reducing transport cost and inference latency for robotic learning from demonstration.
tldr_zh: Temporal Policy 提出了一种基于随机插值的生成框架，从机器人的近期历史初始化动作生成，从而降低了传输成本和推理延迟，用于机器人模仿学习。

title: TRACT: Temporally Routed Action Chunks with Chronological Phase Authority for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Action chunking shortens the effective decision horizon of robot imitation learning by predicting multiple future actions, while conventional phase conditioning describes the current control instant. When a predicted horizon crosses a procedural boundary, assigning the current phase to the entire chunk creates a structural temporal mismatch. We present TRACT, which factorizes phase-structured action chunking into an accepted current phase and a single CURRENT-to-NEXT boundary inside the future horizon. A task-local graph constrains chronological phase authority, and a cumulative boundary distribution monotonically routes future queries through phase-specific query and action paths. For contact execution, a causal response-deficit integrator compares policy intent with ACK-eligible subsequent motion, accumulates arm compensation when directional response is suppressed, and decays after confirmed recovery. Across six real-robot variants with ten trials each, full TRACT achieves 10/10 full-sequence success, 99.00 [88.75, 100.00]% median [min, max] wipe completion, zero observed phase ambiguity, and zero stalls. Under the current complete method package and evaluation setting, the routed representation obtains better observed task results than the flat package (6/10 vs. 3/10 success; 77.08% vs. 8.03% median wipe completion). Chronological authority reduces observed phase ambiguity from 8/10 to 0/10, and response integration reduces stalls from 4/10 to 0/10. The package comparison does not isolate routing from other generator-package differences.
summary_zh: 动作分块通过预测多个未来动作缩短了机器人模仿学习的有效决策时域，而传统的相位条件化描述的是当前控制时刻。当预测时域跨越程序边界时，将当前相位分配给整个分块会产生结构性的时间错配。我们提出TRACT方法，该方法将相位结构化的动作分块分解为已被接受的当前相位，以及未来时域内单个“当前-下一个”边界。任务局部图约束了时间顺序的相位权限，累积边界分布通过相位特定的查询和动作路径单调地路由未来查询。在接触执行中，因果响应赤字积分器将策略意图与可确认的后续动作进行比较，在定向响应被抑制时累积手臂补偿，并在确认恢复后衰减。在六种真实机器人变体（每种进行十次试验）中，完整的TRACT实现了10/10的全序列成功，中位数[最小值, 最大值]擦拭完成度为99.00% [88.75%, 100.00%]，未观察到相位歧义，且无停滞。在当前完整方法包及评估设置下，路由表示获得的观察任务结果优于平坦包（成功率6/10 vs. 3/10；中位数擦拭完成度77.08% vs. 8.03%）。时间顺序权限将观察到的相位歧义从8/10降至0/10，响应积分将停滞从4/10降至0/10。但包对比并未将路由与其他生成器包的差异分离开来。
tldr: TRACT proposes a temporal routing mechanism for action chunking in contact-rich manipulation, using phase authority and a causal response-deficit integrator to resolve procedural boundary mismatches, achieving high success on real-robot wiping tasks.
tldr_zh: TRACT提出一种用于接触丰富操作的动作分块时间路由机制，通过阶段性权威和因果响应不足积分器解决程序边界不匹配问题，在真实机器人擦拭任务中取得高成功率。

title: Event-Based Upper-Body Humanoid Teleoperation Under Challenging Illumination
summary: We present a real-time upper-body human-to-humanoid motion imitation framework driven by neuromorphic event-based vision. This work addresses practical perceptual bottlenecks of conventional frame-based RGB sensors, specifically their difficulty in high dynamic range (HDR) scenes and rapid motions due to fixed integration times. By leveraging the Prophesee EVK4 event camera, which operates asynchronously with high temporal resolution and a dynamic range exceeding 120 dB, our system supports stable tracking in conditions where standard vision pipelines degrade, such as severe backlighting and very low light environments below 5 lux. The architecture integrates a low-latency Perception Module, utilizing optimized event accumulation and gravity-aligned inertial fusion, with a causal Motion Module (TWIST) that performs online kinematic retargeting. We validate the system on an embedded NVIDIA Booster T1 platform and an 18-DoF humanoid upper-body setup, demonstrating an end-to-end photon-to-action latency of 23-34 ms and advantages over RGB baselines under our experimental setup. The results indicate a practical trade-off: events can be preferable for fast or poorly lit upper-body teleoperation, whereas well-lit static scenes may favor RGB or hybrid sensing.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于神经形态事件视觉驱动的实时上半身人形机器人运动模仿框架。该工作解决了传统基于帧的RGB传感器在实际感知中的瓶颈问题，特别是其在固定积分时间下难以应对高动态范围场景与快速运动。通过利用异步运行且具有高时间分辨率（动态范围超过120 dB）的Prophesee EVK4事件相机，本系统在标准视觉流程退化的条件下（如强逆光环境及低于5 lux的极低光照环境）仍能实现稳定跟踪。架构集成了低延迟感知模块（采用优化的事件累积与重力对齐惯性融合算法）与因果运动模块（TWIST，执行在线运动学重定向）。我们在嵌入式NVIDIA Booster T1平台及18自由度人形上半身装置上验证了该系统，证明其端到端光子到动作延迟为23-34毫秒，并在实验条件下优于RGB基线方法。结果表明了实际权衡：事件相机更适合快速运动或光照不足的上半身遥操作，而光照良好的静态场景则可能更适于RGB或混合传感方案。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time upper-body human-to-humanoid teleoperation system using event-based vision that robustly handles challenging illumination conditions like low light and high dynamic range, validated on an 18-DoF humanoid with 23-34 ms latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于事件相机的实时上半身人形机器人遥操作框架，能在低光照和高动态范围等恶劣光照条件下稳定运行，并在18自由度人形机器人上实现了23-34毫秒的端到端延迟。

title: CLIFT: Turning Gemini Robotics On-Device into Humanoid Specialists via Non-Invasive Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning
summary: While robot foundation models are growing increasingly capable, the strongest models are typically trained on proprietary data and remain closed-source, limiting downstream users' ability to adapt them to new tasks, embodiments, and deployment settings. Following the LLM community, an emerging access paradigm for closed-weight robot foundation models is the managed supervised fine-tuning (SFT) API, where users submit training data and receive a tuned policy without access to model weights, gradients, or training internals. While such APIs let downstream users leverage powerful proprietary foundation models, they restrict policy improvement to pure imitation, ruling out reinforcement learning and other closed-loop methods that rely on internal training signals. This limitation is particularly acute for agile, contact-rich humanoid manipulation, where the gap between policy outputs and deployed behavior is large due to novel states, action tracking dynamics, latency, and controller-specific failure modes. We study how effective this managed-API regime is for humanoid adaptation, and how closed-loop improvement can be realized within it to push policies toward task mastery. We conduct one of the first empirical studies of managed-API adaptation on a real humanoid, instantiated on Gemini Robotics On-Device (GROD). We find that direct SFT through the API substantially outperforms a leading open-weight VLA trained on the same demonstrations, yet still falls short of deployment-level mastery on agile, contact-rich tasks. To close this gap, we introduce CLIFT: Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning, which turns deployment-time reward feedback into API-compatible supervised data and enables closed-loop policy improvement without accessing weights, gradients, likelihoods, or losses-pushing GROD to near-perfect success after two flywheel cycles, all without "opening the model box."
summary_zh: 虽然机器人基础模型的能力日益增强，但最强模型通常基于专有数据训练且保持闭源，限制了下游用户适应新任务、具身形态及部署环境的能力。遵循大语言模型社区的发展路径，针对闭权重机器人基础模型的新兴访问范式是托管式监督微调（SFT）应用程序接口——用户提交训练数据即可获得调优后的策略，无需接触模型权重、梯度或训练内部机制。此类应用程序接口虽能让下游用户利用强大的专有基础模型，却将策略改进限制在纯模仿学习范畴，排除了依赖内部训练信号的强化学习及其他闭环方法。这一限制对需要敏捷性、强接触的人形机器人操作尤为突出——因新型状态、动作追踪动力学、延迟及控制器特定故障模式的存在，策略输出与部署行为之间存在巨大差距。本研究探讨托管式应用程序接口机制对人形机器人领域自适应的有效性，以及如何在其框架内实现闭环改进以推动策略达成任务精通。我们首次在真实人形机器人上开展托管式应用程序接口适配实证研究，基于Gemini Robotics On-Device（GROD）实现。研究发现，通过该应用程序接口直接进行监督微调的性能显著优于基于相同示范数据训练的领先开源视觉-语言-动作模型，但在敏捷性、强接触任务中仍无法达到部署级精通。为弥合这一差距，我们提出闭环迭代微调（CLIFT），该方法将部署阶段的奖励反馈转化为与应用程序接口兼容的监督数据，在不访问权重、梯度、似然度或损失函数的情况下实现闭环策略改进——经两轮飞轮迭代后推动GROD趋近完美成功率，全程无需"打开模型黑箱"。
tldr: CLIFT enables closed-loop policy improvement for humanoid manipulation within the constraints of a managed fine-tuning API, achieving near-perfect success on contact-rich tasks without accessing model weights or gradients.
tldr_zh: CLIFT在受管理的微调API限制下实现了人形机器人操作的闭环策略改进，在不访问模型权重或梯度的情况下，在接触密集型任务上达到接近完美的成功率。

title: ActFovea: Runtime Safeguarding for VLA Policies via Spatiotemporal Visual-Action Consistency
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation but remain vulnerable to runtime disturbances that break the temporal alignment among visual observations, robot states, and executed actions. We introduce ActFovea, a plug-and-play safeguarding framework that detects and mitigates such failures without retraining or modifying the underlying VLA policy. ActFovea uses robot kinematics, proprioceptive states, and recent actions to construct action-conditioned foveated regions that retain contact-relevant areas and predicted motion corridors while suppressing task-irrelevant visual content. It detects runtime risks by evaluating whether visual motion and observation freshness remain consistent with geometric, proprioceptive, and action transitions. For recoverable disturbances, ActFovea constructs disturbance-specific candidate observations and accepts a recovery only after verifying the resulting action chunk. When stale or replayed observations make reliable recovery impossible, it invokes a bounded safe-failure procedure. In closed-loop evaluations of $π_0$ across multiple LIBERO suites, ActFovea increases success under localized visual overlays from 49.3\% to 90.3\%, closing 93.7\% of the gap to clean performance. It further improves success under action drift and visual delay by 7.0 and 9.8 percentage points, respectively, while preserving clean-task performance. Under frozen-observation replay, ActFovea triggers timely safe failure in all trials, with no unprotected failures. These results demonstrate that spatiotemporal visual-action consistency provides an effective basis for runtime safeguarding of VLA policies.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在机器人操作中展现出强大的性能，但依然容易受到运行时干扰的影响，这些干扰会破坏视觉观测、机器人状态与执行动作之间的时间对齐。我们提出ActFovea，一种即插即用的安全防护框架，无需重新训练或修改底层VLA策略即可检测并缓解此类故障。ActFovea利用机器人运动学、本体感知状态及近期动作，构建基于动作约束的中央凹区域，保留接触相关区域与预测运动走廊，同时抑制与任务无关的视觉内容。它通过评估视觉运动与观测新鲜度是否与几何、本体感知及动作转换保持一致来检测运行时风险。对于可恢复的干扰，ActFovea构建针对干扰的候选观测，并在验证由此产生的动作块后执行恢复。当陈旧或重放的观测导致无法进行可靠恢复时，它将调用有限的安全失效程序。在跨多个LIBERO套件对π₀进行的闭环评估中，ActFovea在局部视觉覆盖下的成功率从49.3%提升至90.3%，弥补了与无干扰性能之间93.7%的差距。此外，它在动作漂移和视觉延迟场景下分别将成功率提升了7.0和9.8个百分点，同时保持了无干扰任务性能。在冻结观测重放的测试中，ActFovea在所有试验中均触发了及时的安全失效，未出现无防护的故障。这些结果表明，时空视觉-动作一致性为VLA策略的运行时安全防护提供了有效基础。
tldr: ActFovea is a plug-and-play safeguarding framework that detects and mitigates runtime disturbances in VLA policies by enforcing spatiotemporal visual-action consistency, significantly improving robustness in robotic manipulation without modifying the underlying policy.
tldr_zh: ActFovea 是一个即插即用的安全保障框架，通过强制时空视觉-动作一致性来检测和缓解 VLA 策略在运行时的干扰，在不修改底层策略的情况下显著提升机器人操作的鲁棒性。

title: Outcome-Guided Distillation: A Teacher-Student Framework to Advance VLM Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving aims to learn a direct mapping from visual observations to control actions. However, these E2E models often act as black boxes and struggle with complex scenarios. To address this, recent works incorporate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to provide explicit reasoning, enhancing both interpretability and driving robustness. These approaches typically rely on pre-generated annotations, which suffer from potentially flawed labels and require costly human labor. In this work, we propose a new framework that integrates structured reasoning and geometric precision through a teacher-student architecture. The teacher model introduces reflective reasoning, where the VLM generates logical explanations and then reflectively refines the reasoning under the supervision of ground-truth action. This enhances zero-shot generalization without intermediate labels. The student model distills the teacher's reasoning capabilities via supervised fine-tuning. We also design a separate waypoint decoder that interprets textual reasoning into continuous trajectories. Our proposed solution integrates two goals: providing explicit reasoning for interpretability and delivering robust and accurate driving performance. It leverages the synergy between these two objectives within a staged inference engine to enhance driving performance and explicitly uses the reasoning to guide driving prediction. Evaluated on Waymo benchmarks, our framework outperforms classical reasoning-based baselines in zero-shot reasoning, waypoint accuracy, and inference efficiency. Our experiments validate this design, demonstrating that the reasoning text makes a significant contribution to driving inference, resulting in around a 24% improvement in performance compared to an identical model that lacks reasoning. Our work advances reasoning-driven autonomous driving toward interpretable and deployable systems.
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶旨在学习从视觉观测到控制动作的直接映射。然而，这些端到端模型通常表现为黑箱系统，难以应对复杂场景。为应对这一挑战，近期研究引入视觉语言模型提供显式推理，从而增强可解释性与驾驶鲁棒性。现有方法通常依赖预生成的标注数据，但这类数据存在标签缺陷问题且需要高昂的人工成本。本研究提出一种基于教师-学生架构的新框架，该框架融合了结构化推理与几何精度。其中教师模型引入反思性推理机制：视觉语言模型首先生成逻辑解释，随后在真值动作监督下对推理过程进行反思优化。该方法无需中间标注即可提升零样本泛化能力。学生模型通过监督微调蒸馏教师模型的推理能力。我们还设计了独立的路点解码器，将文本推理转化为连续轨迹。所提方案整合双重目标：既为可解释性提供显式推理，又实现鲁棒精准的驾驶性能。通过阶段式推理引擎中两目标的协同作用提升驾驶表现，并显式利用推理指导驾驶预测。在Waymo基准测试上的评估表明，本框架在零样本推理、路点精度及推理效率方面均优于基于推理的经典基线方法。实验验证了该设计的有效性：相比缺乏推理机制的同等模型，推理文本对驾驶推理的显著贡献带来了约24%的性能提升。本研究推动推理驱动型自动驾驶向可解释、可部署的系统迈进。
tldr: A teacher-student framework for autonomous driving that uses a VLM to generate and refine reasoning under action supervision, improving interpretability and trajectory accuracy.
tldr_zh: 一个用于自动驾驶的师生框架，通过动作监督让VLM生成并优化推理，提升可解释性和轨迹精度。

title: Auto-JEPA: A Latent World Model of Continuous Intent for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Existing autonomous-driving world models typically perform dense prediction of future videos, occupancy states, BEV representations, or agent motion. We argue that planning need not reconstruct the complete future world, but only focus on scene features that affect future ego action. Based on this perspective, we propose Auto-JEPA, an action-oriented latent world model that learns continuous future driving intent through joint-embedding prediction. Given visual observations, egomotion history, and navigation commands, Auto-JEPA predicts an intent embedding aligned with the latent representation of the future ego trajectory. The predicted intent retrieves executable trajectories from a fixed trajectory memory, which are then ranked by a scene-conditioned candidate selection module. Auto-JEPA keeps the visual encoder frozen, requires no explicit perception annotations, and uses no learned trajectory generator. By optimizing only task-specific modules for trajectory representation, intent prediction, and candidate selection, Auto-JEPA achieves 91.3 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 89.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. Semantic occlusion experiments show that masking dynamic-agent regions induces an average intent change 2.97x that of equal-area random masking. Moreover, occluding vehicles that affect future driving substantially changes the predicted intent and selected trajectory, whereas both remain essentially unchanged when non-influential vehicles are occluded. These results show that future-intent prediction encourages the model to focus on planning-relevant visual features and supports high-quality planning without dense future-world modeling.
summary_zh: 现有的自动驾驶世界模型通常会对未来视频、占据状态、BEV表示或智能体运动进行密集预测。我们认为，规划无需重建完整的未来世界，只需关注影响未来自车行为的场景特征。基于此视角，我们提出Auto-JEPA——一种面向动作的隐空间世界模型，通过联合嵌入预测学习连续的未来驾驶意图。在给定视觉观测、自车运动历史及导航指令的条件下，Auto-JEPA预测与未来自车轨迹的隐空间表示对齐的意图嵌入。该预测意图从固定的轨迹记忆库中检索可执行轨迹，并通过场景条件化的候选选择模块对其进行排序。Auto-JEPA冻结视觉编码器，无需显式的感知标注，也不使用任何学习型轨迹生成器。通过仅优化轨迹表示、意图预测与候选选择等任务专用模块，Auto-JEPA在NAVSIM v1上达到91.3 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到89.1 EPDMS。语义遮挡实验表明，遮挡动态智能体区域导致的平均意图变化是等面积随机遮挡的2.97倍。此外，当遮挡影响未来驾驶的车辆时，预测意图与所选轨迹发生显著改变，而遮挡不影响驾驶的车辆时，两者基本保持不变。这些结果表明，未来意图预测鼓励模型聚焦于与规划相关的视觉特征，无需对未来世界进行密集建模即可支持高质量规划。
tldr: Auto-JEPA proposes an action-oriented latent world model for autonomous driving that predicts continuous future driving intent via joint-embedding prediction, avoiding dense future-world reconstruction and achieving high planning performance.
tldr_zh: Auto-JEPA 提出了一种面向自动驾驶的动作导向潜在世界模型，通过联合嵌入预测来学习连续的驾驶意图，避免重建完整的未来世界，并实现了高规划性能。

title: ST-WAM: Semantic-Temporal World Action Model for Robust Manipulation under Visual Distribution Shifts
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm by jointly modeling robot actions and future visual dynamics. However, their reliance on pixel-generative future supervision can entangle action-relevant state transitions with task-irrelevant visual content, limiting robustness under visual distribution shifts. We identify Training-Distribution Hallucination, a recurring phenomenon in which futures conditioned on visually shifted observations hallucinate training-domain content rather than remain faithful to the current scene. A controlled frame-triplet diagnosis further shows that DINOv3 features remain more stable across visual shifts while better preserving task-state distinctions than Wan-VAE latents. Rather than correcting the predicted futures, we propose Semantic-Temporal WAM (ST-WAM) to improve action robustness by using DINOv3 as a shared semantic representation for future prediction and history retrieval while retaining fine-grained VAE dynamics. Its Dual-Space Future Experts (DSFE) jointly predict future VAE latents and DINO features, while Current-Anchored Intent Retrieval (CAIR) retrieves task-relevant evidence from recent DINO history under the current visual-language context. ST-WAM is trained end-to-end without additional embodied pretraining or task-specific annotations, and requires no explicit future generation at inference. It achieves 98.7% on LIBERO and 92.8% on RoboTwin 2.0; more importantly, compared with Fast-WAM, it improves zero-shot LIBERO-Plus performance by 21.3 percentage points and more than doubles real-world success under visual shifts from 25.8% to 61.5%. These results demonstrate that semantic-temporal modeling effectively complements pixel-generative dynamics for robust manipulation.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模机器人动作与未来视觉动态，已成为一种颇具前景的范式。然而，其依赖于像素生成式的未来监督会导致动作相关的状态转换与任务无关的视觉内容相纠缠，限制了在视觉分布偏移下的鲁棒性。我们识别出训练-分布幻觉现象——即基于视觉偏移观测的未来状态会幻觉出训练域内容，而非忠实反映当前场景。通过受控帧三元组诊断进一步发现：DINOv3特征在视觉偏移下保持更稳定，同时比Wan-VAE潜变量更优地保留了任务状态区分度。不同于直接修正预测的未来状态，我们提出语义-时序世界模型（ST-WAM），通过将DINOv3作为未来预测与历史检索的共享语义表征（同时保留细粒度VAE动态特性）来提升动作鲁棒性。其双空间未来专家（DSFE）联合预测未来VAE潜变量与DINO特征，而当前锚定意图检索（CAIR）则在当前视觉-语言上下文中从近期DINO历史中检索任务相关证据。ST-WAM无需额外具身预训练或任务特定标注即可端到端训练，推理时也无需显式生成未来状态。它在LIBERO上达到98.7%，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到92.8%；更重要的是，相比Fast-WAM，它将零样本LIBERO-Plus性能提升21.3个百分点，并在视觉偏移下将真实世界成功率从25.8%提升至61.5%，实现翻倍以上提升。这些结果表明，语义-时序建模能有效补充像素生成式动态机制，从而实现鲁棒操作。
tldr: ST-WAM proposes a semantic-temporal world action model that uses DINOv3 features for future prediction and history retrieval, improving manipulation robustness under visual distribution shifts without requiring explicit future generation at inference.
tldr_zh: ST-WAM提出一种语义-时间世界动作模型，利用DINOv3特征进行未来预测和历史检索，在不需显式未来生成的情况下提升了视觉分布偏移下机器人操作的鲁棒性。

title: Mirror Learning
summary: We investigate imitation learning through the lens of third-person observation and propose a framework for mirror learning: acquiring actionable policies from passive observation. While behavior cloning (BC) excels under dense, well-aligned first-person data, it fundamentally fails to leverage the rich observational signals arising from third-person demonstrations that humans and animals routinely exploit. We introduce a method that composes (i) a learned perspective transformation that places learners in demonstrators' shoes using a fine-tuned video diffusion model and (ii) an inverse dynamics model that infers action trajectories in the learners' control space. This enables the synthesis of mirror data, pseudo first-person expert data generated from third-person observations of demonstrator behavior. Empirically, we show that mirror data alone can train effective policies, and that augmenting first-person BC training with mirror data further improves downstream policy performance. Our results suggest that modern generative world models implicitly encode sufficient structure to enable a scalable and safe alternative to teleoperation-heavy data collection.
summary_zh: 我们从第三人称观察的角度探究模仿学习，并提出一个镜像学习框架：通过被动观察获取可执行的策略。虽然行为克隆（BC）在密集且对齐良好的第一人称数据上表现出色，但它从根本上无法利用第三人称演示中丰富的观察信号——这正是人类和动物日常依赖的学习方式。我们提出了一种方法，该方法结合了：（i）利用微调视频扩散模型学习视角变换，使学习者能够站在演示者的角度观察；（ii）通过逆动力学模型在学习者的控制空间中推断动作轨迹。这使得我们能够合成镜像数据——即从第三人称观察演示者行为生成的伪第一人称专家数据。实验表明，仅凭镜像数据即可训练出有效的策略，而将镜像数据与第一人称行为克隆训练相结合，能进一步提升下游策略的表现。我们的研究结果表明，现代生成式世界模型已隐式编码了足够的结构性信息，能够提供一种可扩展且安全的替代方案，减少对繁重遥操作数据采集的依赖。
tldr: A framework that uses a fine-tuned video diffusion model and inverse dynamics to convert third-person demonstrations into first-person training data for imitation learning, enabling policy learning without teleoperation.
tldr_zh: 提出一个框架，利用微调的视频扩散模型和逆动力学将第三人称演示转换为第一人称训练数据，从而实现无遥操作模仿学习。

title: Bootstrapping Self-Supervised Learning of Binary Classification Using Error Bounds: A Case Study on a Robotic Insertion Task
summary:
Flexible manufacturing requires rapid deployment of solutions and minimal setup time to remain competitive. An essential attribute is the ability to control error levels, as failures can range from minor performance degradation to severe equipment damage. However, conventional deployment often involves extensive setup, data collection, model training or parameter tuning, and system testing, resulting in significant delays that hinder commercial feasibility. We propose a data engine which gathers data and improves its performance while executing the task. The data engine consists of two classifiers, a fast model prediction and expensive verification. First, a model prediction is performed and based on the confidence level of the prediction, the expensive verification can be used. By adjusting the confidence level, users can control the level of tolerable error.
  Our method is implemented on a real-world robotic insertion task, which uses force data for the model prediction. The system applies UMAP dimensionality reduction and uses Wilson-Score to compute the confidence bounds of the prediction. Results demonstrate the ability to learn and reduce the need for expensive verifications over time, while staying within the set error-rate. The results highlight the potential of confidence bounds in self-improving models to enhance reliability in robotic classification task.
summary_zh:
柔性制造需要快速部署解决方案并最大限度缩短设置时间以保持竞争力。控制误差水平是关键能力，因为故障可能从轻微性能下降到严重设备损坏不等。然而，传统部署通常涉及大量设置、数据收集、模型训练或参数调整以及系统测试，会导致显著延迟，从而阻碍商业可行性。我们提出一种数据引擎，它能够在执行任务过程中收集数据并提升自身性能。该数据引擎由两个分类器组成：快速模型预测与高成本验证。首先执行模型预测，并根据预测的置信水平决定是否使用高成本验证。通过调整置信水平，用户可控制可容忍的误差程度。

该方法已在真实世界的机器人插入任务中实现，该任务使用力数据进行模型预测。系统采用UMAP降维方法，并利用Wilson-Score计算预测的置信区间。结果表明，该方法能够随时间推移进行学习，减少对高成本验证的需求，同时将误差率控制在设定范围内。研究结果凸显了置信区间在自改进模型中提升机器人分类任务可靠性的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a self-supervised data engine for binary classification that uses confidence bounds (Wilson-Score) to control error rates, demonstrated on a real robotic insertion task with force data and UMAP dimensionality reduction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用置信界限（Wilson-Score）控制错误率的自监督数据引擎，用于二分类任务，并在真实机器人插入任务中使用力数据和UMAP降维进行了验证。

title: Balancing of Humanoid with Object Mass: Trade-off Analyses and Lifting Control
summary: The demand for humanoid loco-manipulation tasks with an object has recently increased, and most existing control approaches for stability in such tasks rely on heuristics or machine-learning techniques. This study rigorously analyzes and exploits the dynamic effects of the object mass on balance stability. By formulating the object mass parameters in the whole-body dynamics with distributed contact wrenches and centers of pressure at the stance contacts, their nonlinear effects on the system momenta and constraints are quantified. The dynamic models and constraints are incorporated into the construction of the balanced state basin/boundary (BSB), a partition of the center-of-mass state space for a biped system to maintain balance in its desired contacts. The implications of the BSB for prediction and control are highlighted using a humanoid robot and an analytically tractable reduced-order mechanism. The BSBs under different conditions of base of support, actuation capacity, and pose provide systematic analyses of the effects of object mass on the balancing capability of a system. In particular, the trade-off relationships between momentum regulation and limiting factors in balancing are characterized, introducing two key quantities of the object: the critical mass, at which the system's balancing capability is maximum, and the transition mass, which activates different limiting factors. In addition, sufficient conditions for imposing balanced states on a trajectory are established and implemented with BSBs as explicit threshold constraints in the whole-body trajectory optimization for stable object-lifting control of the humanoid, demonstrating the lift-and-hold and lift-and-release tasks with distinct mass properties in simulations and experiments.
summary_zh: 近期，携带物体的人形机器人全身协调操作任务需求日益增长，现有大多数针对此类任务稳定性的控制方法依赖于启发式算法或机器学习技术。本研究严格分析并利用了物体质量对平衡稳定性的动态影响。通过将物体质量参数纳入包含分布接触力与站位接触压力中心的全身动力学模型，量化了这些参数对系统动量及约束的非线性影响。将动力学模型与约束融入平衡状态流域/边界（BSB）的构建中——即双足系统在期望接触状态下维持平衡的质心状态空间划分。通过人形机器人及可解析处理的降阶机构，突显了BSB在预测与控制中的作用。不同支撑基底、驱动能力及姿态条件下的BSB为系统分析物体质量对平衡能力的影响提供了系统性方法。特别地，刻画了动量调节与平衡限制因素之间的权衡关系，引入物体两个关键质量参数：使系统平衡能力达到最大的临界质量，以及激活不同限制因素的过渡质量。此外，建立了轨迹施加平衡状态的充分条件，并将BSB作为显式阈值约束融入人形机器人稳定抬升物体的全身轨迹优化中，通过仿真与实验验证了不同质量属性下的抬升-保持与抬升-释放任务。
tldr: The paper systematically analyzes the effect of object mass on humanoid balancing using the balanced state basin (BSB) and formulates lift-and-hold/release control via constrained trajectory optimization.
tldr_zh: 该论文系统分析了物体质量对双足人形机器人平衡稳定性的影响，利用平衡状态盆地（BSB）构建约束，并通过轨迹优化实现稳定的物体抬举控制。

title: HAM-VLN: Harnessing Hierarchical Agentic Memory for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) enables robots to follow instructions in previously unseen environments. Recently, a training-free paradigm has emerged: the robot queries a multimodal LLM to understand its observations and plan the next action. However, long-horizon navigation based on either image streams or dense map inevitably introduces a growing memory and reasoning bottleneck. We present HAM-VLN, a decision-coupled, agent-authored memory that equips the robot with a persistent, depth-grounded world graph. In the same model call used to select the next action, HAM-VLN also records semantic and reflective information---including room type, objects, navigation progress, and failure notes. Recent waypoints remain verbatim within a bounded window, while older history re-enters the context only through retrieval scored by relevance, recency, and salience, together with one-hop topological expansion. This design requires no additional LLM calls beyond the per-waypoint decision. Compared to previous methods, HAM-VLN not only improves various navigation metrics but also reduces the context length by more than 65%. Specifically, HAM-VLN achieves 61.0% Success Rate (SR) on VLN-CE R2R, 52.7% SR on VLN-CE RxR, and 79.7% SR on HM3D-v2 ObjectNav without any training.
summary_zh: 视觉与语言导航（VLN）使机器人能够在未知环境中遵循指令执行任务。近期出现了一种免训练范式：机器人通过查询多模态大语言模型来理解其观察内容并规划下一步行动。然而，基于图像流或稠密地图的长时域导航不可避免地会引发不断增长的记忆与推理瓶颈。我们提出HAM-VLN——一种决策耦合、智能体自主撰写的记忆机制，为机器人配备持久化且具有深度基础的世界图。在与选择下一步行动相同的模型调用中，HAM-VLN同时记录语义与反思信息——包括房间类型、物体、导航进度及失败记录。近期航点以逐字形式保留在有限窗口内，而较早的历史信息仅通过相关性、时效性与显著性的检索评分，结合单跳拓扑扩展重新进入上下文。该设计无需在每次航点决策之外调用额外的大语言模型。与先前方法相比，HAM-VLN不仅提升了多项导航指标，还将上下文长度减少超过65%。具体而言，HAM-VLN在VLN-CE R2R上取得61.0%的成功率（SR），在VLN-CE RxR上达到52.7%的SR，并在HM3D-v2 ObjectNav上实现79.7%的SR，且无需任何训练。
tldr: Proposes a training-free VLN framework with a hierarchical agentic memory that records semantic/reflective information in a world graph and retrieves relevant history via scored indexing, improving navigation metrics while reducing context length by over 65%.
tldr_zh: 提出一种无需训练的VLN框架，通过分层智能记忆在决策过程中记录语义和反思信息到世界图，并基于相关性、时间与显著性检索历史，在降低65%以上上下文长度的同时提升导航指标。

title: TransGraspNet: Physically and Geometrically Consistent Manipulation of Transparent Labware
summary: Manipulating transparent laboratory glassware that contains liquid is inherently safety-critical: even small geometric errors can cause unstable grasps and hazardous spillage. Although recent progress has been made in transparent object perception and robotic grasping, most existing systems optimize detection, depth reconstruction, and grasp planning independently, which leads to cross-stage inconsistency imperfect boundaries induce depth bleeding, distorted surfaces corrupt normal estimation, and task agnostic grasp scoring yields tilted or off-center grasps that fail under dynamic motion. In this paper, we propose TransGraspNet, a geometry physics consistent framework that explicitly enforces consistency from perception to execution through three coupled principles: boundary consistency to produce structurally reliable object contours as downstream priors, surface consistency to preserve geometric fidelity and surface normal accuracy during depth reconstruction, and physics consistency to refine grasp selection with centroid alignment and wrench-space stability for upright and dynamically robust manipulation. We evaluate TransGraspNet on public benchmarks, a dedicated transparent glassware dataset, and a real robotic platform. The results show improved boundary quality and surface normal fidelity, and demonstrate strong task-level performance in cluttered transparent scenes. Most importantly, the proposed system achieves reliable real-world operation, including high grasp success rates in clutter and zero spillage during high speed liquid transport, highlighting the effectiveness of our method.
summary_zh: 操作装有液体的透明实验室玻璃器皿本质上涉及安全关键问题：即使是微小的几何误差也可能导致抓取不稳并造成危险的液体泄漏。尽管透明物体感知与机器人抓取领域近期取得了进展，但现有系统大多将检测、深度重建与抓取规划独立优化，导致跨阶段不一致性——不完善的边界引发深度溢散、扭曲的表面破坏法线估计、以及任务无关的抓取评分产生倾斜或偏离中心的抓取，从而在动态运动中失效。本文提出TransGraspNet，一个几何-物理一致性框架，通过三项耦合原则明确强制从感知到执行的一致性：边界一致性，生成结构可靠的物体轮廓作为下游先验；表面一致性，在深度重建过程中保持几何保真度与表面法线精度；物理一致性，通过质心对齐与力螺旋空间稳定性优化抓取选择，实现直立且动态鲁棒的操作。我们在公开基准、专用透明玻璃器皿数据集以及真实机器人平台上评估了TransGraspNet。结果表明，该方法提升了边界质量与表面法线保真度，并在杂乱透明场景中展现了强大的任务级性能。最重要的是，所提系统实现了可靠的真实世界操作，包括杂乱环境中的高抓取成功率以及高速液体输送中的零泄漏，彰显了我们方法的有效性。
tldr: TransGraspNet is a geometry-physics consistent framework for manipulating transparent labware, enforcing boundary, surface, and physics consistency to achieve robust, spill-free grasping on real robots.
tldr_zh: TransGraspNet 是一个几何-物理一致的透明实验室器皿操控框架，通过边界、表面和物理一致性实现稳健、无洒落的真实机器人抓取。

title: STAGE: STyle-controllable Action GEneration for personalized autonomous driving
summary: Driving style refers to the behavioral preferences that drivers maintain during driving, shaped by their diverse experiences, habits, and needs, and is typically reflected in varying levels of aggressiveness. If humans choose to use autonomous driving systems, they would expect the driving style of the systems to closely resemble their own habit. However, this is challenging for current industrial autonomous driving systems. To address this, we developed a style controllable action generation method, STAGE, for driving tasks. Its training process is based on imitation learning, incorporating both style value and latent value action modality encoding. Preference learning is then used to identify the user's driving style as a continuous, monotonic style value. And to reduce the cost of human involvement in the preference training process, we also developed a set of rules to compare driving style in data pairs. Then, during inference, the user inputs the style value to control the generated action patterns, dynamically meeting the user's expectations. Using the STAGE method, we verified that the style-controlled action generation results in several typical road scenarios significantly align with human expectations. Furthermore, through comparisons between the STAGE method and various other approaches, we reveal the unique functionalities of STAGE, including its style controllability, style continuity, driving style alignment capability and driving safety. The code for this work is available at: https://github.com/CarlDegio/STAGE
summary_zh: 驾驶风格是指驾驶员在驾驶过程中所表现出的行为偏好，这种偏好由驾驶员的不同经验、习惯和需求塑造，通常体现在不同程度的激进性上。如果人类选择使用自动驾驶系统，他们会期望系统的驾驶风格尽可能接近自己的习惯。然而，这对当前工业界的自动驾驶系统而言是一项挑战。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种用于驾驶任务的风格可控动作生成方法——STAGE。其训练过程基于模仿学习，融合了风格值编码和潜在动作模态编码。随后，通过偏好学习将用户的驾驶风格识别为一个连续且单调的风格值。为了降低偏好训练过程中人工参与的成本，我们还开发了一套用于比较数据对中驾驶风格的规则。在推理阶段，用户输入风格值以控制生成的动作模式，从而动态满足用户的期望。通过STAGE方法，我们验证了在多个典型道路场景中，风格控制的动作生成结果与人类期望高度一致。此外，通过将STAGE方法与多种其他方法进行比较，我们揭示了STAGE的独特功能，包括风格可控性、风格连续性、驾驶风格对齐能力以及驾驶安全性。本工作的代码已开源于：https://github.com/CarlDegio/STAGE
tldr: STAGE proposes a style-controllable action generation method for autonomous driving that uses imitation learning with style and latent action encoding, plus preference learning to align driving style with user expectations.
tldr_zh: STAGE 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的风格可控动作生成方法，通过结合风格值和潜在动作编码的模仿学习以及偏好学习，使驾驶风格符合用户期望。

title: AquaJEPA: Action-Conditioned Multimodal Predictive Representations for Underwater Robot Dynamics
summary: Underwater robots combine complementary sensors whose reliability changes abruptly with water visibility, viewpoint, and vehicle motion. We introduce AquaJEPA, an action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive model that fuses an RGB camera, forward-looking sonar, and proprioception with explicit sensor validity. It predicts a future latent target conditioned on eight-thruster commands and supplies velocity and sonar-profile predictions to a shared receding-horizon planner. We study the method in Stonefish against reactive, state-only, ordinary multimodal, supervised dynamics, and recurrent world-model baselines. We further isolate the EMA target, action margin, masks, and modality dropout. A preregistered 120-environment replication comprises five independent replicates of a grid crossing three unseen obstacle maps, four water-visibility coefficients, and nominal versus shifted dynamics, while intermittently removing DVL observations. In 120 fresh paired environments with scheduled DVL loss, AquaJEPA reaches 74 goals, versus 68 for both state-only and the recurrent world model, and attains the lowest mean final error (0.906 m). Paired final-error reductions relative to ordinary multimodal prediction, supervised dynamics, and the recurrent world model are 0.273 m (95% CI: 0.190-0.356), 0.364 m (0.260-0.468), and 0.106 m (0.025-0.187), respectively. AquaJEPA therefore achieves the best aggregate closed-loop performance and significantly outperforms three action-conditioned predictive baselines in paired final error; its advantage over state-only remains statistically unresolved.
summary_zh: 水下机器人将互补性传感器相结合，其可靠性会随水体能见度、视角和载体运动而发生突变。我们提出AquaJEPA——一种动作条件联合嵌入预测模型，该模型融合RGB相机、前视声纳与本体感知信息，并显式引入传感器有效性参数。该模型以八推进器指令为条件预测未来潜在目标，并向共享的滚动时域规划器提供速度与声纳剖面预测。我们在Stonefish仿真环境中将该方法与反应式基线、纯状态基线、普通多模态基线、监督动力学基线及循环世界模型基线进行对比研究，并进一步分离测试EMA目标、动作裕度、掩膜及模态丢弃等组件。预注册的120环境复制实验包含五个独立重复测试，在三种未见障碍物地图、四种水体能见度系数及标称/偏移动力学条件下进行网格穿越，同时间歇性移除DVL观测数据。在120组含预定DVL丢失的新配对环境中，AquaJEPA达成74个目标，优于纯状态模型与循环世界模型的68个目标，并取得最低平均最终误差（0.906米）。相较于普通多模态预测、监督动力学及循环世界模型，配对最终误差分别降低0.273米（95%置信区间：0.190-0.356）、0.364米（0.260-0.468）和0.106米（0.025-0.187）。因此，AquaJEPA实现了最优聚合闭环性能，且在配对最终误差指标上显著优于三种动作条件预测基线；其相对于纯状态模型的优势尚未达到统计显著性。
tldr: AquaJEPA is an action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive model that fuses RGB, sonar, and proprioception with sensor validity masks to predict future latent representations for underwater robot control, demonstrating improved closed-loop goal-reaching in simulation.
tldr_zh: AquaJEPA 是一种动作条件联合嵌入预测模型，融合 RGB、声纳和本体感觉，利用传感器有效性掩码预测未来潜在表示，从而改善水下机器人的闭环目标到达能力。

title: SAGP: Semantic Affordance-Guided Grasp Planning via Coarse-Zone VLM Reasoning
summary: Geometry-based grasp planners ensure physically valid grasps but ignore functional semantics, often generating grasps that are antipodal and collision-free yet practically inappropriate, for example, gripping a mug by its rim, a knife by the blade, or a bottle near its cap. These inconsistencies cause the downstream task to fail even when traditional grasp metrics are met. Existing vision-language model (VLM) approaches either depend on fine-grained, category-specific part segmentation or attempt to directly infer grasp poses, with the latter prone to spatial hallucinations. As a result, no practical, training-free framework has yet been proposed that robustly links high-level semantic reasoning to geometric grasp planning. We introduce Semantic Affordance-Guided Grasp Planning (SAGP), a training-free pipeline built on a coarse-zone abstraction layer. The method first partitions the object point cloud into spatial regions (top, middle, bottom, lateral sides, and protrusions) by applying PCA-based alignment followed by distance-driven DBSCAN clustering, entirely bypassing learned segmentation. A pre-trained VLM then assesses the grasp quality of each region through a structured zero-shot query, and the resulting zone-wise scores are fused with geometric, reachability, and task-alignment signals to re-rank antipodal grasp candidates. Experiments on YCB objects in PyBullet with a Franka Panda robot show that SAGP preserves the high success rate of geometry-only planning while substantially improving the functional appropriateness of selected grasps, particularly on asymmetric, handle-bearing objects where geometry alone is uninformative. The introduced coarse-zone abstraction offers an effective, training-free bridge between VLM-based reasoning and geometric grasp planning, without the need for fine-grained part segmentation.
summary_zh: 基于几何的抓取规划器能够保证物理上有效的抓取，但忽略了功能语义，常常生成对极且无碰撞、但在实际中不合适的抓取，例如夹住杯子的边缘、刀刃或瓶子靠近瓶盖的位置。这些不一致性会导致即使满足传统抓取度量标准，下游任务依然失败。现有的视觉-语言模型方法要么依赖于细粒度的、特定类别的部件分割，要么试图直接推断抓取姿态，后者容易产生空间幻觉。因此，目前尚无实用的、无需训练的框架能够稳健地将高层语义推理与几何抓取规划相连接。我们提出语义可供性引导的抓取规划(SAGP)，这是一种基于粗区域抽象层的无需训练流程。该方法首先通过基于PCA的配准，再结合距离驱动的DBSCAN聚类，将目标点云划分为空间区域（顶部、中部、底部、侧边和凸起部分），完全绕过学习型分割。随后，一个预训练的视觉-语言模型通过结构化零样本查询评估每个区域的抓取质量，并将得到的区域分数与几何、可达性和任务对齐信号融合，以重新排序对极抓取候选。在PyBullet中使用Franka Panda机器人对YCB物体进行的实验表明，SAGP在保持纯几何规划的高成功率的同时，显著提升了所选抓取的功能适当性，尤其对于那些仅凭几何信息无法区分的非对称、带手柄的物体。所提出的粗区域抽象层为基于视觉-语言模型的推理与几何抓取规划之间提供了一种有效且无需训练的桥梁，且无需细粒度的部件分割。
tldr: SAGP introduces a training-free pipeline that uses coarse-zone abstraction and VLM reasoning to re-rank antipodal grasps based on semantic affordance, improving functional appropriateness while preserving geometric success rates.
tldr_zh: SAGP 提出了一种无需训练的方法，通过粗区域抽象和 VLM 推理重新排序对映抓取，在保持几何成功率的同时提高了抓取的功能适切性。

title: MDIR: A Task-Manifold Impedance Retargeting Method for Contact-Rich Teleoperation
summary: Fixed Cartesian impedance makes contact-rich teleoperation demonstrations practical, but gains that secure progress and contact support also determine impact and force variability. We study single-demonstration controller-to-controller impedance retargeting. Given one fixed Cartesian impedance command sequence {K0, D0, xcmd}, Manifold-Decomposed Impedance Retargeting (MDIR) deterministically reparameterizes the recorded controller into an executable task-channel variable-impedance command. MDIR targets this local retargeting problem by preserving projected task-channel responses near the demonstrated trajectory. It represents the source response in operational work, exertion, and support channels with a passive residual complement under a control-chain metric, computes an executable Cartesian-to-Manifold Retargeting (C2M) baseline, and applies Manifold-Constrained Parameter Optimization (MPO) to select a feasible representative with lower wrist-force peaks, impulse, force variability, and nominal controller power. Across planar wiping, pick-and-place, and pushing on a Franka Panda, the full MDIR controller passes Task Check in all 15 closed-loop executions and reduces all four aggressiveness metrics relative to the fixed-impedance demonstrations.
summary_zh: 固定笛卡尔阻抗使得高接触遥操作演示具有实用性，但确保进程稳定与接触支撑的增益参数同样决定了冲击力与力变异性。本研究探讨单次演示中控制器到控制器的阻抗重定向问题。给定固定笛卡尔阻抗指令序列{K0， D0， xcmd}，流形分解阻抗重定向（MDIR）方法将记录的控制器确定性地重参数化为可执行的任务通道变阻抗指令。MDIR通过保持演示轨迹附近投影任务通道的响应特性来瞄准这一局部重定向问题。该方法在控制链度量下以无源残差补集表征源响应的工作、施力与支撑通道，计算可执行的笛卡尔到流形重定向（C2M）基线，并应用流形约束参数优化（MPO）选取具有更低腕部力峰值、冲量、力变异性及标称控制器功率的可行表征。在Franka Panda机器人上开展的平面擦拭、拾放与推拉操作实验中，完整MDIR控制器在全部15次闭环执行中通过任务校验，且相较于固定阻抗演示降低了全部四项激进性指标。
tldr: A method for retargeting a fixed Cartesian impedance demonstration into a variable task-channel impedance command to reduce aggressiveness in contact-rich teleoperation, validated on a Franka Panda robot.
tldr_zh: 一种将固定笛卡尔阻抗演示重新映射为可变任务通道阻抗命令的方法，旨在减少接触丰富遥操作中的攻击性，在Franka Panda机器人上验证。

title: TacPrint: A Wearable Fingertip Tactile Sensor for Human-to-Robot Contact Reproduction
summary: Human-centric data collection is emerging as a significant paradigm for robot skill acquisition, but seamlessly integrating low-cost, scalable tactile sensing systems that capture fine-grained fingertip interactions without compromising natural operation remains a key challenge. This reduces the reliability of human-to-robot transfer in contact-rich tasks. In this work, we present TacPrint, a wearable fingertip tactile sensor, where protrusions on the inner surface of the silicone skin are aligned one-to-one with 24 capacitive taxels to enable localized capacitive responses. A real-to-sim-to-real pipeline estimates a 35 $\times$ 26 contact-depth map from 24-channel capacitive signals. Against simulation-generated labels, the model achieved a contact-region RMSE of 0.223 $\pm$ 0.161 mm, a weighted-centroid error of 1.213 $\pm$ 2.379 pixels, and an IoU of 0.829 $\pm$ 0.169. With measured capacitive inputs, the network-predicted depth evaluated at the guide-calibrated contact center showed a mean absolute error of 0.085 $\pm$ 0.057 mm across all 40 controlled trials, while the mean contact-position error was 0.250 $\pm$ 0.208 mm across the 37 trials whose reference contact regions were not truncated by the sensing boundary. In human-to-robot replay, tactile-guided compensation increased grasping and wiping success rates from 0% to 91.67% and 90%, respectively. In closed-loop grasping, dense-depth feedback achieved success rates of 87.5% over all tested positions and 85% under edge-contact conditions, compared with 67.5% and 45% for raw-taxel feedback.
summary_zh: 以人为中心的数据收集正成为机器人技能获取的重要范式，但在不影响自然操作的前提下，无缝集成低成本、可扩展的触觉传感系统以捕捉细粒度指尖交互，仍是一项关键挑战。这降低了接触密集型任务中人机迁移的可靠性。本文提出TacPrint——一种可穿戴指尖触觉传感器，其硅胶皮肤内表面的凸起与24个电容式触觉单元一一对齐，从而实现局部电容响应。通过"真实-仿真-真实"流程，我们可从24通道电容信号中估计出35×26的接触深度图。基于仿真生成的标签，模型实现了接触区域均方根误差0.223±0.161 mm、加权质心误差1.213±2.379像素以及IoU 0.829±0.169。在实测电容输入下，经导引校准接触中心评估的网络预测深度，在全部40次受控试验中平均绝对误差为0.085±0.057 mm；在参考接触区域未被传感边界截断的37次试验中，平均接触位置误差为0.250±0.208 mm。在人类-机器人复现中，触觉引导补偿将抓取和擦拭成功率分别从0%提升至91.67%和90%。在闭环抓取中，密集深度反馈在所有测试位置及边缘接触条件下的成功率分别为87.5%和85%，而原始触觉单元反馈的成功率仅为67.5%和45%。
tldr: TacPrint presents a wearable fingertip tactile sensor with a real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that produces dense contact-depth maps from sparse capacitive signals, enabling reliable human-to-robot skill transfer for contact-rich tasks.
tldr_zh: TacPrint 提出了一种可穿戴指尖触觉传感器，通过真实-仿真-真实管道从稀疏电容信号生成密集接触深度图，实现了接触丰富任务中可靠的从人类到机器人的技能迁移。

title: D-VLC: Decentralized Vision-Language Collaboration for Heterogeneous Embodied Multi-Robot Systems in Unknown Environments
summary: Multi-robot systems, particularly heterogeneous robot swarms, can improve the efficiency of complex task execution through parallel collaboration and complementary capabilities. However, conventional rule-based methods rely on predefined task models and specialized decision making programs, making it difficult to understand complex semantic instructions and coordinate heterogeneous robots. LLMs introduce strong language understanding and task reasoning capabilities, allowing multi-robot systems to interpret instructions, decompose tasks, and assign roles according to task semantics. VLMs further incorporate visual perception, enabling robots to reason about objects, regions, and spatial relationships in physical environments. Nevertheless, existing LLM/VLM based methods often depend on known maps, centralized and synchronized decision making, limiting their generalization to heterogeneous robots and unseen tasks. We therefore propose a framework that combines decentralized asynchronous reasoning, lightweight information sharing, capability aware collaboration, and a unified action interface, enabling general purpose VLMs to generate robot specific actions executed by learning free experts without task or robot specific training. Experiments across diverse scenarios and multiple VLMs show success rates above 70\%, with completion time reduced by up to 55.8\% relative to the geometric greedy baseline.
summary_zh: 多机器人系统，特别是异构机器人集群，能够通过并行协作与能力互补提升复杂任务的执行效率。然而，传统基于规则的方法依赖预定义任务模型和专用决策程序，难以理解复杂语义指令并协调异构机器人。大语言模型（LLM）引入强大的语言理解与任务推理能力，使多机器人系统能够根据任务语义解读指令、分解任务并分配角色。视觉语言模型（VLM）进一步融合视觉感知能力，使机器人能够对物理环境中的物体、区域及空间关系进行推理。然而，现有基于LLM/VLM的方法通常依赖已知地图、集中式同步决策机制，限制了对异构机器人及未知任务的泛化能力。为此，我们提出一种融合去中心化异步推理、轻量化信息共享、能力感知协作及统一动作接口的框架，使通用VLM能够生成由无学习专家执行机器人特定动作，无需针对任务或机器人进行专门训练。跨多种场景与多类VLM的实验表明，该方法成功率超过70%，相较于几何贪婪基线方法，任务完成时间最多缩短55.8%。
tldr: A decentralized framework using general-purpose VLMs enables heterogeneous multi-robot systems to interpret instructions, decompose tasks, and collaborate via lightweight information sharing without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个去中心化框架，利用通用视觉-语言模型使异构多机器人系统能够理解指令、分解任务并通过轻量信息共享进行协作，无需针对特定任务训练。

title: Advances, challenges, and opportunities for legged robots
summary: Humanoid and quadrupedal robots have the potential to revolutionize the way we work, interact, and coexist with intelligent machines. To understand their effects on society and how they can enable scientific discovery, we assess the current capabilities of these systems along hardware, locomotion, autonomy, data, and applications. We identify recent advances and key open challenges that must be overcome to enable widespread adoption and new use cases for legged robots. Last, we provide an outlook on the future of legged robots, exploring their ethical considerations, economic potential, policy implications, and broader societal effects.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
人形与四足机器人有望彻底改变人类与智能机器协同工作、交互及共存的方式。为理解其对社会的深远影响及如何推动科学发现，我们从硬件、运动能力、自主性、数据及应用五大维度评估了当前此类系统的技术现状。我们梳理了近期突破性进展，并明确了实现足式机器人广泛部署及新兴应用场景所需攻克的关键挑战。最后，本文展望了足式机器人的未来发展方向，探讨其伦理考量、经济潜力、政策影响及更广泛的社会效应。
tldr: This paper surveys the current capabilities, recent advances, and key challenges in legged robotics (humanoid and quadrupedal), covering hardware, locomotion, autonomy, data, and applications, with an outlook on societal impact.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了腿式机器人（人形和四足）的当前能力、最新进展和关键挑战，涵盖硬件、运动、自主性、数据和应用，并展望了其社会影响。

title: When Unlearning Fails: Reliable Data Deletion under Post-Training in Agent Networks
summary: Self-improving federated agent networks keep training after deployment by collecting new trajectories with the current policy and feeding them back into later rounds. This closed loop makes unlearning harder than a one-time model repair. When a data owner requests deletion, the target data may have already shaped later retained trajectories, so retraining or model-side unlearning can leave an influence echo that returns as the network continues to operate. We show that this echo survives retained-data retraining, grows with the amount of forget-shaped retained data, and can be traced from deployment, collection, and aggregation records. To address this problem, we propose MUTE, a Muting Unlearned Trajectories' Echoes method for reliable deletion in self-improving federated agent networks. MUTE estimates downstream influence from a lightweight server ledger, removes the current residue through a forget-retain update, contains high-influence retained trajectories through quarantine or down-weighting, and audits later behavior to schedule additional erasure under an uplink budget. Experiments on LIBERO with two vision-language-action backbones, three deletion granularities, and a physical Jetson-based edge testbed show that MUTE keeps behavioral leakage and influence regeneration low while preserving task utility and using much less communication than full retraining.
summary_zh: 自改进联邦智能体网络在部署后持续训练，通过当前策略收集新轨迹并将其反馈至后续轮次。这种闭环机制使得数据删除比一次性模型修复更为困难。当数据所有者请求删除时，目标数据可能已经影响了后续保留轨迹的形成，因此重训练或模型侧删除会产生影响回声，并在网络持续运行过程中反复显现。我们证明，这种回声在保留数据的重训练中依然存在，其强度随受遗忘数据影响的保留数据量增加而增长，并且可从部署、收集与聚合记录中追溯。为解决该问题，我们提出MUTE——一种用于自改进联邦智能体网络可靠删除的“静默遗忘轨迹回声”方法。该方法通过轻量级服务器账本估计下游影响，通过“遗忘-保留”更新消除当前残留，通过隔离或降权处理高影响力保留轨迹，并在上行链路预算约束下审计后续行为以安排额外擦除。在LIBERO平台上使用两种视觉-语言-动作主干网络、三种删除粒度以及基于Jetson的物理边缘测试平台进行的实验表明，MUTE在保持行为泄露与影响再生处于低水平的同时，能够保留任务效用，且通信开销远低于完全重训练。
tldr: This paper addresses the challenge of unlearning in self-improving federated agent networks where data deletion requests can leave influence echoes that persist through continued training, and proposes MUTE (Muting Unlearned Trajectories' Echoes) to mitigate behavioral leakage and influence regeneration with minimal communication cost.
tldr_zh: 本文解决了自我改进的联邦智能体网络中的数据遗忘难题，即在持续训练过程中，删除请求留下的影响回声会长期存在；提出了MUTE（消除遗忘轨迹的回声）方法，以在降低通信开销的同时最小化行为泄露和影响再生。

title: Homotopy-Aware Corridor Generation without Predefined Reference Paths
summary: Generating safe corridors is essential for collision-free robotic motion planning, yet most existing methods rely on predefined reference paths, which bias corridor geometry and implicitly limit the homotopy classes that can be explored. We propose a reference-path-free corridor generation framework on graphs of convex sets (GCS) that constructs corridors directly as sequences of convex sets, allowing corridor structure to emerge from the free-space representation rather than from a guiding path. To reason about similarity among corridors, we extend visibility-based deformation from paths to convex-set sequences, enabling the fusion of topologically redundant corridors while preserving distinct alternatives. To overcome the limited adaptability of existing GCS methods based on static global decompositions, we further develop an adaptive multi-scale GCS, in which a sampling-based fine-scale graph supports localized updates and a visibility-based coarse-scale graph enables compact global exploration. The two levels maintain topological consistency, allowing incremental updates without full graph reconstruction under environmental uncertainty. Numerical experiments characterize GCS construction, corridor generation, homotopy-aware exploration, and local updates, showing efficient graph construction, stable trajectory-level performance, and shorter-duration homotopy-aware trajectories than existing baselines. Hardware experiments on ground and aerial robots, including deployment with onboard localization, further validate the framework under translated and previously unknown obstacles.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
生成安全通道对于无碰撞机器人运动规划至关重要，但现有方法大多依赖预定义参考路径，这会导致通道几何结构产生偏差，并隐含地限制了可探索的同伦类。我们提出了一种基于凸集图（GCS）的无参考路径通道生成框架，该框架直接将通道构建为凸集序列，使通道结构能够从自由空间表示中自然形成，而非依赖于引导路径。为评估通道间的相似性，我们将基于可见性的变形方法从路径扩展到凸集序列，使得在保留不同备选方案的同时，能够融合拓扑冗余的通道。针对现有基于静态全局分解的GCS方法适应性有限的问题，我们进一步开发了一种自适应多尺度GCS：其中，基于采样的细粒度图支持局部更新，而基于可见性的粗粒度图则支持紧凑的全局探索。这两个层级保持拓扑一致性，使得在环境不确定性下无需完全重建图结构即可进行增量更新。数值实验表征了GCS构建、通道生成、同伦感知探索及局部更新过程，结果表明该方法具有高效的图构建能力、稳定的轨迹级性能，并生成了比现有基准方法持续时间更短的同伦感知轨迹。包含机载定位部署的地面与空中机器人硬件实验进一步验证了该框架在障碍物平移及未知障碍物场景下的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a reference-path-free corridor generation framework using graphs of convex sets, enabling homotopy-aware motion planning without biasing corridor geometry. It introduces adaptive multi-scale GCS for local updates and global exploration, validated on real ground and aerial robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种无需参考路径的走廊生成框架，基于凸集图直接构建走廊，支持拓扑感知的运动规划，并在真实地面和空中机器人上验证。

title: Automated Straight-line Sewing of Stretchable Fabrics with Different Lengths
summary: Different Length Alignment Sewing (DLAS), which involves stretching the shorter fabric to match the longer one and sewing them together in a straight line, is a challenging task that needs to satisfy several requirements when automating the sewing process. To address the challenges, this research proposes a novel robotic sewing system, Different Length Robotic Sewing System (DLRoSS), which consists of a roller type end-effector, attached to a 6-DoF manipulator. The end-effector composed of active shorter and longer fabric rollers, and a passive press-roller attached to the shorter-fabric roller. Assuming that one end of the two fabric layers are initially positioned under the sewing machine's presser foot, the system automates DLAS by operating in four distinct phases. (P1) Fabric wrapping: Individual fabric layers are picked, held, and wrapped from the other end onto the feed rollers. (P2) Sewing: During the sewing, the shorter fabric is stretched and aligned with the longer fabric in real-time using roller velocity control based on the sewing speed and apriori known length ratio. (P3) Sewing completion: In the final sewing round on the fabric rollers, the press roller is engaged to prevent the stretched fabric from slipping off due to internal tension. (P4) Sewing fabric release: At the end of sewing, the fabric edge moves past the press roller, and the fabric releases from the rollers. Experimental results demonstrate that DLRoSS achieves consistent, high-quality sewing of stretchable fabrics of different materials and lengths.
summary_zh: 不同长度对齐缝纫（DLAS）涉及将较短织物拉伸至与较长织物匹配，并沿直线缝制在一起。这是一项具有挑战性的任务，在自动化缝纫过程中需满足多项要求。为应对这些挑战，本研究提出了一种新型机器人缝纫系统——不同长度机器人缝纫系统（DLRoSS），该系统由一个安装在六自由度机械臂上的滚筒式末端执行器构成。该末端执行器由主动式短织物滚筒与长织物滚筒，以及一个安装在短织物滚筒上的被动式压辊组成。假设两层织物的其中一端初始位于缝纫机压脚下方，系统通过四个不同阶段实现自动化DLAS：（P1）织物包裹：依次拾取、夹持单层织物，并将其另一端包裹至进料滚筒上。（P2）缝纫：缝纫过程中，基于缝纫速度及预先已知的长度比，通过滚筒速度控制实时拉伸较短织物，使其与较长织物对齐。（P3）缝纫完成：在织物滚筒上的最后缝纫阶段，启用压辊以防止因内部张力导致拉伸织物滑脱。（P4）缝纫织物释放：缝纫结束时，织物边缘移过压辊，织物从滚筒上释放。实验结果表明，DLRoSS能够对多种不同材料与长度的可拉伸织物实现一致且高质量的缝纫效果。
tldr: This paper presents a robotic sewing system (DLRoSS) with a roller-based end-effector on a 6-DoF arm that automates the straight-line sewing of stretchable fabrics of different lengths by stretching the shorter fabric in real-time during sewing.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种机器人缝纫系统（DLRoSS），该系统的末端执行器基于滚轮并安装在6自由度机械臂上，能够在缝纫过程中实时拉伸较短布料，实现不同长度弹性布料的直线拼接自动化。

title: CorrelationFlow: A Training-Free Geometric Approach for LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation
summary: LiDAR scene flow estimation has settled into a monoculture: nearly all recent methods share the same feed-forward architecture and the same family of self-supervised losses, inheriting each other's assumptions, and each other's blind spots. When those assumptions fail, as they do for sparse, distant, or fast-moving objects, every method built on them fails together, and adding parameters or simulated training data does not fix what the formulation itself gets wrong. This paper takes the opposite path. We present CorrelationFlow, a training-free geometric framework that reduces scene flow to two textbook operations: connected-component labeling and correlation maximization on bird's-eye-view occupancy images. Objects are isolated as spatio-temporal connected components, their motions recovered as correlation peaks, and the resulting velocities propagated to all member points. However, this dense correlation evaluates every candidate displacement of every cluster and requires a window of past sweeps; therefore, we develop a sparse counterpart that operates on a single sweep pair by matching lightweight occupancy descriptors at boundary key points. Because nothing is trained, nothing is inherited: on the multi-domain test set of the Argoverse 2 2026 Scene Flow Challenge, spanning five datasets with heterogeneous sensors and platforms, CorrelationFlow ranked second among unsupervised methods and degrades most gracefully at long range, where the shared assumptions of learned methods break down. Our results suggest that a substantial share of the scene flow problem is solvable by classical computer vision, and that progress may require questioning the formulation, not scaling it.
tldr: CorrelationFlow is a training-free geometric method for LiDAR scene flow estimation that uses connected-component labeling and correlation maximization on bird's-eye-view occupancy images, achieving strong performance without learned parameters.
tldr_zh: CorrelationFlow 是一种无需训练的几何方法，用于 LiDAR 场景流估计，它通过对鸟瞰占用图像进行连通分量标记和相关性最大化，在无需学习参数的情况下实现了强劲性能。

title: DART: Dual-Axis Airborne Reachability-Gated Torque-Reaction for Off-Road Vehicle Jumps
summary: Traversing crests, ledges, and ditches at high speed often launches vehicles into the air, and a mishandled landing presents a substantial crash hazard. We show that the airborne phase is barely controllable: on a 1383 kg platform the wheel angular-momentum budget caps the recoverable pitch-rate change at roughly $9$-$13^\circ$/s in the tighter nose-up direction under drive at typical takeoff wheel speeds, and at about twice that in the reverse-inclusive braking direction; driving the wheels to their drivetrain hard limit raises the measured nose-up ceiling to only $16$-$18^\circ$/s. Takeoff pitch-rate disturbances beyond this directional budget are physically unrecoverable in flight, so the decisive leverage lies before takeoff. DART (Dual-Axis Airborne Reachability-Gated Torque-Reaction) back-propagates the landing constraint into a closed-form certified feasible-takeoff set, which supplies a conservative go/no-go condition and a pre-takeoff speed-shaping law. In flight, DART regulates pitch and roll via steer-resolved wheel-reaction torque, governed by a per-flight roll latch derived from the yaw-coupling analysis. In deterministic full-scale simulation in BeamNG.tech, a calibrated pre-takeoff speed regulator reduces touchdown speed by 36% and raises on-target landings from 0/30 to 30/30. Under the same steep-lip approach the airborne law completes 29/30 safe landings under crash-avoidance bounds versus 0/30 for reaction-wheel-style PD (RW-PD) and time-optimal bang-bang (TOBB). On banked run-ups DART holds the median pitch error at or below $2^\circ$ at every cross-slope, with the largest baseline separation at $γ=12^\circ$. Across disturbance regimes, the latch preserves pitch-only allocation on low-disturbance entries and enables dual-axis control when roll becomes binding. All results are from simulation; hardware validation remains open.
tldr: DART proposes a dual-axis airborne reachability-gated torque-reaction controller for off-road vehicle jumps, which uses a certified feasible-takeoff set and steer-resolved wheel-reaction torque to improve landing safety in simulation.
tldr_zh: DART 提出了一种用于越野车辆跳跃的双轴空中可达性门控力矩反应控制器，通过认证的可行起飞集合和转向解析的车轮反应力矩来提高着陆安全性。

title: Receding-Horizon Next-Best-View Planner for Autonomous Leaf Surface Reconstruction
summary: Accurate plant leaf modeling is fundamental to downstream tasks such as plant growth monitoring, and phenotyping for yield estimation. Autonomous robotic reconstruction for large-scale field deployment must address limitations on robot planning budget and computation resources while optimizing viewpoint utility for leaf surface reconstruction. Existing approaches either focus on rigid objects, point-cloud coverage or plant reconstruction without fully addressing the system limitations or exploiting task-driven point cloud utility. In this work, we study next-best-view (NBV) planning for leaf surface reconstruction under travel constraints. We develop a novel Centroid-based Information Gain (CIG) function that measures the spatial distribution of observed points relative to the centroid of the existing point cloud to compute viewpoint utility. We also develop a receding-horizon variant that reasons over future viewpoints. To benchmark our work, we use the LAST-STRAW [1] public dataset that includes point clouds of strawberry plants over different growth stages and compare our method with attention-driven NBV [2] that uses a visibility-based information gain approach. The proposed receding-horizon approach consistently reduces surface reconstruction error and improves geometric fidelity across multiple growth stages, especially under increased inter-leaf occlusion. Results demonstrate that our approach is able to visit viewpoints that reduce surface reconstruction error and improves reconstruc-tion accuracy as compared to the baseline by upto 10%.
tldr: This paper proposes a receding-horizon next-best-view planner with a centroid-based information gain function for autonomous leaf surface reconstruction, improving reconstruction accuracy by up to 10% under travel constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于质心信息增益的滚动时域下一最佳视角规划器，用于自主叶片表面重建，在旅行约束下将重建精度提升了高达10%。

title: Group-wise Supervision with Focal-Dice Loss for Long-Tailed Indoor Semantic Occupancy Prediction
summary: Recently, 3D semantic occupancy prediction has garnered increasing attention for understanding the indoor scene. However, unlike structured outdoor environments, indoor scenes feature a high diversity of object categories that exhibit a severe long-tailed distribution, which has become a core bottleneck limiting the performance of existing models. To tackle this challenge, we propose a novel method, Group-UFD Occ, based on hierarchical semantic supervision and synergistic loss optimization. At the architectural level, we introduce a fine-grained semantic grouping strategy and design multi-scale, parallel ``main-expert'' prediction heads to guide the model in efficiently learning tail-class features through deep regularization. At the optimization level, we introduce the Unified Focal-Dice (UFD) loss. This synergistic loss function dynamically focuses on hard samples at the per-voxel level. Meanwhile, it simultaneously optimizes the geometric integrity of predicted objects from a region-based perspective. We conducted experiments on the large-scale EmbodiedScan dataset.
